entries.title: Open and reverse a money movement
entries.need: A wrong expense or transfer could not be opened or put right, so balances drifted with no trail.
entries.now: Any money row opens a side panel with its details, note and receipts; Reverse asks why and adds a mirror entry.
entries.where: Finances › Cash, bank & wallets (/money) and Finances › Income & expenses (/expenses-bills), tap a row
try: Open Income & expenses and tap an expense
Press Reverse, write why and confirm
See the Reversal row and the Reversed tag
Open a transfer in Cash, bank & wallets and reverse it: both sides go back

entries.title: Receipt photo, place, VAT and monthly expenses
entries.need: Expenses had no receipt, no branch, no VAT and rent or internet had to be typed again every month.
entries.now: Record expense takes a receipt photo, the place, VAT on the bill and Repeat every month; repeating ones are listed with Stop.
try: Press Record expense
Pick Rent, add a photo, a place and VAT
Tick Repeat every month and save
See it under Repeats monthly and press Stop

entries.title: Notification centre and personal settings
entries.need: The bell showed five made-up rows that all opened the orders list, and nobody could choose what to get.
entries.now: The bell shows real items from the shop; View all opens a page with filters, read and unread, and each person's settings.
entries.where: Top bar bell › View all notifications (/notifications), Settings tab (/notifications?tab=settings)
try: Open the bell in the top bar
Press View all notifications
Tap a row to open its page
Open Settings and switch Sound on for New orders
entries.left: Email and SMS are kept as a choice only; sending them needs the server.

entries.title: Top bar Invoices, Files and Scan work
entries.need: Invoices showed fixed numbers, Files and Upload did nothing, and Scan always found the same product.
entries.now: Invoices lists the latest real invoices, Files opens the media library, and Scan looks up the code typed or scanned.
entries.where: Top bar: Invoices, Files and Scan buttons
try: Press the Invoices button and open one
Press Scan, type a product SKU and press Enter
Press Open product
Press the Files button

entries.title: Analytics menu shows the analytics pages
entries.need: The Analytics menu listed pixel setup pages while the real analytics pages were hidden in the reports list.
entries.now: Analytics lists Reports, Daily summary, Scheduled reports and the marketing, campaign, attribution, traffic, team and alert pages.
entries.where: Menu › Analytics; pixel setup now under Settings › Connections
try: Open the Analytics area in the menu
Open Marketing performance
Open Settings › Connections › Meta ads to reach Pixels & events

entries.title: Home charts follow the page
entries.need: Home repeated the order and customer lists, used its own date pickers and called three statuses New.
entries.now: Home keeps three cards that follow the chosen day and place: Sales summary, Order summary with the Orders tabs, and Stock alert.
try: Open Home
Pick Yesterday and a branch at the top
See the charts change
Tap On hold in Order summary

entries.title: No made-up counts in menu and settings
entries.need: The menu and settings list showed counts and warnings that never changed.
entries.now: Fixed menu counts are gone; the settings dots for couriers, mail and SMS follow what is connected.
try: Open the Inventory area: no fixed numbers
Open Settings › General and look at Courier Settings and SMS

entries.title: More of the app in Bangla
entries.need: Bangla mode left reports, money and payroll pages mostly in English and the toast said pages stay English.
entries.now: Reports, money pages, payroll, attendance, leave and staff pages read in Bangla, and the language toast is short.
entries.where: Account menu › Language › বাংলা, then Analytics › Reports, Finances, Staff & HR
try: Switch the language to বাংলা
Open Analytics › Reports
Open Finances › Income & expenses
Open Staff & HR › Payroll
entries.left: Sentences built with numbers, the HR setup, shifts and money setup pages still have English lines.

entries.title: Profile switch only as a demo tool
entries.need: The demo switch between team roles looked like a real store setting.
entries.now: It shows only on review builds, marked as a demo tool; sign-in and Switch account still change people.
entries.where: Settings list and account menu (review builds only)
try: Open Settings: Profile type is not listed
Open the account menu: no Profile type row

entries.title: No placeholder copy for shop owners
entries.need: Sign-up terms were not links, onboarding said to replace a sample story, Home help was wrong and Watch tutorial did nothing.
entries.now: Terms and Privacy open GridCommerce's pages, onboarding shows plain product lines, Home help matches the page, no empty tutorial.
entries.where: Sign-in › Create account; Onboarding; Help on Home
try: Open sign-in, create account and tap Terms of Service
Open onboarding and read the side panel
Open Home and press Help
